items.name: country-types
items.title: Country types
items.description: The CountryConfig type and shared locale and currency types. Required by every country and by components that read country data.

items.name: prefix-range
items.title: Prefix range
items.description: prefixRange() expands a regulator's numeric range, such as 650 to 653, into individual phone prefixes.

items.name: country-cm
items.title: Cameroon
items.description: Country data for Cameroon: operators and prefixes, XAF currency, FR/EN locales, regions and cities. Prefixes were verified against the ART numbering plan; region and city names are still unverified community data.

items.name: i18n
items.title: FR/EN dictionary
items.description: Small French and English dictionary and translator used by every MPUI-KIT component. Supports overriding any string.

items.name: format-fcfa
items.title: formatFcfa
items.description: Formats CFA franc amounts (XAF and XOF) with zero decimals and French spacing, for example 25 000 FCFA.

items.name: phone
items.title: Phone utilities
items.description: Parses local and international phone numbers, detects the operator from the prefix, validates length and returns E.164.

items.name: countdown
items.title: formatCountdown
items.description: Formats a duration in milliseconds as m:ss for countdown timers.

items.name: checkout-machine
items.title: Checkout state machine
items.description: Pure reducer for the payment flow: idle, awaiting approval, success, failed and timeout, with retry and stale-result protection.

items.name: mpui-kit-provider
items.title: MpuiKitProvider
items.description: Context provider for country data, UI language and string overrides, plus the useCountry, useLocale and useT hooks used by every MPUI-KIT component.

items.name: currency
items.title: Currency
items.description: Displays an amount of CFA francs (XAF or XOF) with zero decimals and French spacing, for example 25 000 FCFA. Shows FCFA or the ISO code.

items.name: phone-errors
items.title: Phone error messages
items.description: Turns a phone validation issue into a translated, user-facing message in French or English.

items.name: phone-schema
items.title: Phone zod schema
items.description: createPhoneSchema(country) returns a zod schema that accepts what people type and outputs the E.164 number, with translated error messages.

items.name: operator-badge
items.title: OperatorBadge
items.description: A neutral badge for a mobile operator: a color dot (or your own logo) and the name. Ships no brand assets.

items.name: phone-input
items.title: PhoneInput
items.description: A phone number field that groups digits as you type, detects the operator from the prefix, validates the length and returns the E.164 number. Works with react-hook-form and zod.

items.name: payment-methods
items.title: Payment methods
items.description: The payment methods a country offers (Mobile Money per operator, card, cash) and resolvePayment(), which tells you whether a selection is ready to pay.

items.name: payment-method-picker
items.title: PaymentMethodPicker
items.description: Selectable cards for Mobile Money operators, card, cash and methods you add. Choosing Mobile Money reveals a phone input; any method can show your own panel. Built on native radio inputs.

items.name: clipboard
items.title: copyToClipboard
items.description: Copies text to the clipboard with a fallback for older Android WebViews and non-secure pages. Resolves to whether it worked; never throws.

items.name: dial
items.title: dialHref
items.description: Builds a tel: link for a USSD code with # percent-encoded, and refuses text that is not dialable.

items.name: use-countdown
items.title: useCountdown
items.description: Time left until a deadline as a React hook: a thin layer over the framework-free countdown controller.

items.name: ussd-prompt
items.title: UssdPrompt
items.description: Asks the user to approve a Mobile Money payment on their phone: approval code with copy and dial actions, an animated waiting state, a countdown and a retry button after the timeout.

items.name: format-date
items.title: formatDateTime
items.description: Formats a Unix time as a short date and time in French or English.

items.name: use-momo-checkout
items.title: useMomoCheckout
items.description: The payment flow as a React hook: a thin layer over the framework-free checkout controller.

items.name: receipt-card
items.title: ReceiptCard
items.description: A confirmation card for a successful payment: amount, method, phone, reference and date, plus extra rows and an optional Done button.

items.name: method-panel
items.title: MethodPanel (beta)
items.description: Beta. Types for hosting your payment provider's card or PayPal fields inside the checkout. Card details never enter MPUI-KIT: the panel returns an opaque token.

items.name: momo-checkout
items.title: Mobile Money checkout
items.description: A complete checkout: choose Mobile Money, card or any method you add, then approve and see a receipt. Host your provider's card or PayPal fields in a panel (beta). You provide onPay and onCheckStatus; it never talks to a provider itself and never sees card details.

items.name: core-store
items.title: Core store
items.description: A tiny observable store (getState, setState, subscribe). It is all a UI framework adapter needs: it fits React's useSyncExternalStore, a Vue ref, a Svelte store or a plain render function.

items.name: checkout-controller
items.title: Checkout controller
items.description: The Mobile Money payment flow with no UI framework in it: it calls your onPay, polls onCheckStatus, times out, retries and cleans up, and lets any UI subscribe to its state.

items.name: phone-field
items.title: Phone field core
items.description: The behaviour of a phone number field with no UI framework in it: grouping digits as you type, keeping the caret in place, deleting a digit when Backspace lands on a space, detecting the operator and validating.

items.name: countdown-controller
items.title: Countdown controller
items.description: A countdown with no UI framework in it. It ticks exactly on the second, works the time left out from the real clock, and re-checks when the page becomes visible again.

items.name: use-phone-field
items.title: usePhoneField
items.description: A headless phone field for React: all the behaviour of PhoneInput with none of its markup. Spread getInputProps() on any input.
